items.caption:
What do you say in your sleep?
In a 2017 sleep-lab study of 232 adults, most of them people with sleep disorders, "no" was the most common word and about 1 in 10 clauses (9.7%) contained swearing. Only 15 of the 232 were healthy sleepers, so yours may differ.
